title: 长板图片尺寸审计失败时必须标记需要重出

required_behaviors: 禁止作为交付结果展示
forbidden_behaviors: 把短图标记为已生成通过

command:
tmp=$(mktemp -d); export PMW_HOME="$tmp/home"; export PMW_PROJECT_SLUG=audit-test; mkdir -p "$PMW_HOME/projects/audit-test"; python3 - "$tmp/ref.png" 1179 2556 "$tmp/img.png" 862 1825 <<'PY'
import struct, sys, zlib
args=sys.argv[1:]
def png(path,w,h):
    raw=b''.join(b'\x00'+b'\xff\xff\xff' * w for _ in range(h))
    def chunk(t,d):
        import zlib, struct
        return struct.pack('>I',len(d))+t+d+struct.pack('>I',zlib.crc32(t+d)&0xffffffff)
    data=b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'+chunk(b'IHDR',struct.pack('>IIBBBBB',w,h,8,2,0,0,0))+chunk(b'IDAT',zlib.compress(raw,1))+chunk(b'IEND',b'')
    open(path,'wb').write(data)
png(args[0],int(args[1]),int(args[2])); png(args[3],int(args[4]),int(args[5]))
PY
bin/pmw-image-audit baseline --reference "$tmp/ref.png" --register >/dev/null; bin/pmw-prototype-board add --scheme 方案A --screen 首屏 --brief-version v1 --canvas-mode physical_longboard --target-output-pixels '目标输出 1179 x >=2556' >/dev/null; set +e; bin/pmw-prototype-board image --scheme 方案A --screen 首屏 --image "$tmp/img.png"; code=$?; cat "$PMW_HOME/projects/audit-test/prototype-board.jsonl"; rm -rf "$tmp"; exit $code
